newsitem.title: USA: Moovies adopts shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Moovies adopts shareholder rights plan.

text.p: Moovies Inc said on Monday that it has adopted a shareholder rights plan under which it will distribute a dividend of one right to purchase a fraction of a share of a newly created class of preferred stock.
Each share of common stock will receive a single right. It is to be distributed at the close of business on December 31.

The rights, which are set to expire December 31, 2006, would be exercised only if an individual or group acquired 15 percent or more of Moovies' common stock. The company said it was not adopting the rights plan in response to any takeover threat and that it knows of no such threats. Moovies operates 220 video special stores in 16 states.
